fields.description:
## Context / Problem
`tests/integration/test_fold_cross_clone_horizon.py` failed in 3 of the Nov 19-20 2026 local `make verify` runs on oversubscribed hosts and passes in CI: `test_snapshot_repair_on_stale_clone_keeps_concurrent_tag` with "SETUP: the merge must land B's tag" (verify-willet.log) and "SETUP: A must hold a COMMENT orphan to repair" (bug-create-replay make-verify.log), and `test_fold_on_stale_clone_keeps_concurrent_tag` (fix-ref-lock-test-bound). Both are setup assertions, not the behavior under test.

## Root cause (verified): two load-sensitive setup assumptions
Each test drives two clones through real `rebar` child processes and needs exact control over what each clone has seen. Two production behaviors, both correct and best-effort by design, break that control on a slow host:
1. Delivery. A rebar write pushes best-effort: `push_tickets_branch` bounds each `git push` at 30 s, retries a timed-out push (3 attempts), and never fails the write (`src/rebar/_store/push.py`). When every attempt times out, the write exits 0 without reaching origin, and the other clone's next fetch misses it.
2. Freshness. Every rebar read surface reconverges from origin when its 60 s freshness marker has expired (`ensure_fresh` in `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py`). `store compact --skip-sync` skips only the compact's own pre-fetch. When more than 60 s of wall time pass between B's write and A's fold, A's compact fast-forwards to origin first (A's reflog shows `reset: moving to origin/tickets` immediately before `COMPACT`), so A absorbs B's comment and there is no orphan: "SETUP: A must hold a COMMENT orphan to repair".

Deterministic reproductions (Nov 20 2026, origin/main 8e1d15e664f):
- A PATH `git` shim that fails rebar's own pushes fast (argv `push origin HEAD:tickets`, without `-q`) makes both tests fail at setup in about 8 s each (B cannot see A's ticket); without the shim they pass.
- A shim that sleeps 32 s before every push makes the steps take minutes. With only fix 1 applied, `test_snapshot_repair_on_stale_clone_keeps_concurrent_tag` still fails with "SETUP: A must hold a COMMENT orphan to repair", and A's reflog shows the read-sync reset.

## Approach
Make both preconditions explicit and checked in the test module; no product code changes.
- `_publish(tracker)`: a checked `git push -q origin HEAD:tickets` from a clone's tracker (a no-op when the best-effort push already landed), called after every write a later cross-clone fetch depends on: A's create and comment, B's comment, B's tag edit. `store compact ... --skip-sync` never pushes, so A's later writes are only read by A.
- `_PINNED_VIEW = {"REBAR_SYNC_PULL": "off"}`, the existing documented switch that disables read reconvergence, passed to A's 3 steps that must not see B's newest write: the compact in each test and the `store fsck --repair-snapshots` run.

## Scope
- `tests/integration/test_fold_cross_clone_horizon.py`

## Testing
- Fast fail-push shim: both tests pass after the change (they fail before it), runs recorded here.
- Reproduction harness: under the 32 s push shim each rebar write spends about 92 s in its retried push and each `_publish` about 32 s, so the shim runs pass `-o timeout=1800` on the pytest command line to lift the 300 s per-test budget for that run only; the module carries no new marker. Under the shim both tests pass after the change (they fail before it), runs recorded on this ticket.
- Without the shim both tests still pass.
- The module's existing assertions on SNAPSHOT placement, tag survival and fsck orphan rows are unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both fold cross-clone tests pass under the fail-push shim, under the 32 s push shim (with `-o timeout=1800`), and without a shim (default budget), runs recorded here.
- [ ] Clone A's fold and repair steps run with read reconvergence disabled.
- [ ] Every cross-clone fetch in the module follows a checked publish of the write it depends on.
- [ ] `make verify` passes on the change and Gerrit gives Verified +1.
fields.title: Fold cross-clone tests assume best-effort pushes landed and no read-sync ran; a slow host breaks their setup
